response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, staff-level generalist engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure work, but he lacks the specific 8+ years of AI/GenAI production experience the role demands. His only AI-related exposure is a few months at his current role (since April 2025) touching MCP tooling, with no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, multi-agent frameworks, or cloud-native AI system design. Python is notably absent from his skill set.
strengths: 15+ years of staff-level software engineering with broad technical range (web, mobile, embedded, infrastructure)
Demonstrated mentoring and technical leadership through workshops, talks, and team engagements
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic workflow tooling at current role
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years building AI/GenAI production systems; AI experience appears limited to a few recent months
No mention of Python, vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI) in skills or experience
No clear track record of major cloud platform AI system design (AWS/GCP/Azure) or client-facing technical discovery for AI solutions

key_factors.factor: Lack of substantial AI/GenAI production experience
Missing core required skills (Python, RAG, vector DBs, multi-agent frameworks)
Strong general staff-level engineering and mentoring background
